verdict.rationale: Penpot documents its own API surfaces: an access-token-authenticated API, an open plugin API with "extensive access to objects and properties", and an MCP server for agents. Nothing in the evidence states that these surfaces match everything the UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec to confirm coverage. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec showing endpoint coverage of UI features (components, prototyping, tokens, export), and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Get extensive access to objects and properties to enable external rendering, workflow automation, enhanced app functionality, and more.
